shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat panel
justification: A shows only abstract chevron/herringbone and branching linear motifs in vertical columns on a pillar face, with no figures, while B shows a fully figural scene: a rayed disc whose rays end in hands, two standing figures with elaborate headdresses making offerings at a laden altar, smaller attendant figures, and dense columns of script signs. The only correspondence is the generic fact of shallow relief carving with repeated vertical linear elements, which any carving tradition could produce independently; no shared motif, relationship or scheme is present.
